title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] CO adsorption sites on Pt(111) at low coverage from IRRAS and XPS
citation: Synthetic fixture for pipeline testing; not a real publication.
objective: Identify the adsorption sites of CO on Pt(111) at 0.25 ML coverage and 300 K.
key_findings: A p(2x2) LEED pattern is observed at 0.25 ML.
IRRAS shows a strong C-O stretching band at 2090 cm-1 and a weak band at 1850 cm-1.
C 1s XPS shows a main component at 286.8 eV and a minor component at 286.1 eV.
author_interpretations: The 2090 cm-1 band is assigned to CO bound atop a single Pt atom and the 1850 cm-1 band to bridge-bonded CO.
Atop CO is the majority species at 0.25 ML; bridge CO is a minority species.
reconstruction_target: CO adsorbed on a Pt(111) slab at 0.25 ML
unresolved: The ratio of atop to bridge CO is not quantified.
Whether hollow sites are occupied is not addressed.
